slash_commands_not_executed.finding: The plugin registers five commands in extension.mjs (goalanchor-status, goalanchor-python, goalanchor-guard, goalanchor-approve, goalanchor-check) but manifest.json declares only one contributed command (goalanchor.capabilities).
slash_commands_not_executed.observed: /goalanchor-status, /goalanchor-guard on and /goalanchor-status again were typed and submitted in the composer; none produced visible output, and plugin.log recorded zero command or guard events.
slash_commands_not_executed.interpretation: On host 0.22.0 the slash commands registered through the agent extension are not reaching the plugin, while the manifest-declared command works. This blocks the guard -> approve -> one-time consumption -> receipt path from the desktop composer.
slash_commands_not_executed.not_a_conclusion_about: It does not show the guard logic is wrong; guard.cjs and the approval flow remain untested from this host.

verified: PI-Desktop 0.22.0 installed plugin upgraded from 0.6.0 to 0.9.3 through the host Plugins page
manifest, runtime and registry all report 0.9.3 with status ready and enabled true

one LOW-risk single-round review completed successfully on 0.9.3 with verdict WARN (plugin.log ok=true, 1m 9s)
not_verified: guard enablement, exact approval, one-time consumption, receipt, UNKNOWN/reconcile and closure from the desktop composer: the registered slash commands produced no output and no log entries on 0.22.0
boundary: Real desktop session on a real host. A WARN review verdict is recorded as a completed review, not as a pass. The guard path is recorded as blocked by the host command surface, not as a product defect proven by test.
